title: Sample-Centric Multi-Task Learning for Detection and Segmentation of Industrial Surface Defects
mechanism: A plug-in sample-level defect/no-defect head on the top encoder stage whose loss backpropagates only into the encoder, pushing features toward small low-contrast defects; plus per-sample Seg_Recall / Sample_mIoU metrics.
adaptation: 269 of 478 train cells lack cracks, so a cell-level crack-present head is informative; add crack and inactive presence heads on ResNet-34 layer4 of house / PF, also per 128 px tile for a local signal; report cell-level Seg_Recall in the benchmark.
evidence: R: KSDD2 DeepLabv3+ mIoU 53.2 to 58.2, Seg_Recall 72.7 to 82.7; SegNet mIoU 55.1 to 61.9; DeepLabv3 Seg_Recall dropped 71.7 to 65.5; road Crack set small gains; single runs.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + crack/inactive presence heads (cell + 128 px tile), weight 1; baseline: PF; metric: CV crack relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90 and cell-level Seg_Recall; kill if relR@2 gain < +0.02.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF s5 (classification heads never tried); D27 holds Bozic stop-grad cls head, this variant sends cls gradient into the encoder.
